name: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Limited
summary: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the infrastructure and environmental protection, real estate, consumer products, and comprehensive healthcare operations businesses in Hong Kong, the People's Republic of China, rest of Asia, and internationally. The company invests in toll road and bridge projects; and water services/clean energy businesses. It also engages in property development and investment activities, as well as hotel operations. In addition, the company manufactures and sells cigarettes, packaging materials, and printed products; and pharmaceutical and healthcare products.
